name: claude-octopus
description: Unofficial. A pixel Claude that shows your Claude Code usage quota and context, and eats what Claude reads.

commands.title: Claude Octopus: Cycle Motion Level (lively / calm / minimal)

claudeOctopus.contextWindow.description: Context window size in tokens, used for the context line of the tooltip and for /compact. 0 (default) learns it per model from your Claude Code history (more than 200k means a 1M window). Set a number to force it.

claudeOctopus.compactThreshold.description: How full the conversation's context must be before the details offer /compact (and before a click on the tank octopus compacts).

enumDescriptions: Most recently active session of the open workspace folder(s); falls back to the latest session anywhere.
Most recently active Claude Code session in any project.

claudeOctopus.terminalNamePattern.description: Case-insensitive regex used to find the terminal that runs Claude Code. If no single terminal matches you are asked to pick one. User settings only: a workspace cannot change it.

claudeOctopus.confirmBelowThreshold.description: Ask before running /compact on a double-click while the context is still below the threshold.

claudeOctopus.sleepAfterMinutes.description: Tank view only (Activity Bar, Explorer or panel): the octopus falls asleep after this many minutes without session activity. The floating mascot only sleeps when a usage limit is hit.

enumDescriptions: All animations, including the flashing 'about to burst' effects at 100%.
No flashing or view shaking; slower pulses and fewer idle antics. Easy on the eyes while coding.
Almost still: only size, colour and gentle breathing. No particles or wandering.
claudeOctopus.motion.markdownDescription: How much it moves. `minimal` also stops the floating mascot eating while Claude works.

enumDescriptions: Its own icon in the Activity Bar.
A small section inside the Explorer sidebar.
A tab in the bottom panel, next to the terminal.
macOS: a tiny pixel Claude on top of the Claude Code chat box, floating over VS Code with a transparent background (other systems use the Activity Bar).
No view at all, only the status bar item.
White eyes, like the Claude Code mascot.
Dark eyes.
claudeOctopus.eyes.description: Eye colour of the floating mascot.

claudeOctopus.gymReminder.markdownDescription: Daily time (`HH:MM`, local) when the floating mascot lifts weights for 15 minutes to remind you to go to the gym. Leave empty to turn it off.

claudeOctopus.quietWhileTyping.description: Tank view only (Activity Bar, Explorer or panel): hold still (no particles, speech or wandering) for a few seconds after every edit you make.

claudeOctopus.showSpeech.description: Tank view only (Activity Bar, Explorer or panel): show speech bubbles. Important alerts are always shown.

claudeOctopus.showStatusBar.description: Show the usage quota in the status bar (the context when Claude Code has not cached the quota yet).

enumDescriptions: Detect from the transcript (which cache bucket Claude wrote to); falls back to 1 hour.
5-minute prompt cache.
1-hour prompt cache.
claudeOctopus.cacheTtl.description: Tank view only (Activity Bar, Explorer or panel): how long Claude's prompt cache lives. Once it expires the octopus goes into deep sleep: the next message has to re-read the whole context.

enumDescriptions: Pick by date: Messi farewell (6/10/2026), birthday 24/6 and 18/12 · 20/10 and 8/3 · Christmas · Lunar New Year (Tet).
Never dress up.
Argentina jersey, beard, captain armband, football and three stars. GOAT 🐐
Flower crown, a rose and falling petals for Vietnamese Women's Day (20 Oct) and International Women's Day (8 Mar).
Santa hat, snow and presents.
Lanterns, red envelopes and apricot blossoms for Lunar New Year (Tet).
claudeOctopus.theme.description: Tank view only (Activity Bar, Explorer or panel): seasonal outfit for the octopus.

claudeOctopus.themeDates.markdownDescription: Tank view only (Activity Bar, Explorer or panel): Extra dates for themes (they win over built-in ones). Dates are `YYYY-MM-DD` or yearly `MM-DD`, e.g. `[{ "theme": "messi", "from": "2026-10-03", "to": "2026-10-07" }]`.

claudeOctopus.vibeAfterSeconds.description: After Claude has been working non-stop this long, the mascot switches to vibe coding: sunglasses and head nods while you wait.

claudeOctopus.boredAfterSeconds.description: Tank view only (Activity Bar, Explorer or panel): after this long without any session activity the octopus gets bored.

claudeOctopus.knowledgeLabels.description: Tank view only (Activity Bar, Explorer or panel): show short labels (file names, command descriptions, the start of your prompt) on the knowledge chips the octopus eats. Anything that looks like a secret is always masked; turn this off to show icons only, e.g. while screen sharing.

enumDescriptions: Share of the quota (or context) already used.
Share still left.
claudeOctopus.percentDisplay.description: How the status bar percentage is shown: used or left.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode the settings that choose which terminal /compact is typed into and which sessions are read cannot be set by the workspace.
